name: Flexible Asset Allocation (126d lookback)
description: Slower-signal variant of Flexible Asset Allocation (Keller & van Putten, 2012) using a ~6-month (126-day) lookback for the return, volatility, and correlation factor ranks. Combines with weights (1.0, 0.5, 0.5), selects top 3, and applies the absolute-momentum gate to the safe asset.
